title: SMPL machines: knob C
author: Iced-Cream
description: A companion of smpl-machines: a value of its own for knob C of the SMPL machines that ask for one (SMPL_OWN_C), so turning it never changes the sample stock plays (SMP's word). One lockable sound field and one knob id: p-locks, scenes, performances, the LFO, velocity and aftertouch routes and a MIDI CC come from core. Only a mod with such a machine needs it; it lists smpl-knob-c in its requires.
